items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Babs Gonzalez' group of 1947' in a parenthetical note while discussing the origin of the word 'bebop'. The interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond with any personal anecdote, memory, or confirmation of a relationship with Babs Gonzalez.
